column1: # League code -> the league's own name, for the Ask Athena menu.
# Typed by hand, culture and not data, exactly like countries.tsv: the
# engine never reads this and nothing derives from it.
# The name here carries NO country, because the menu already prints one:
# the row reads "🇫🇷 France - Ligue 1", so a stored "French Ligue 1"
# would say France twice. That is the whole reason this file exists next
# to the names in config/leagues.json — those are engine-side labels
# ("German 2. Bundesliga") and seven of the leagues on the board have no
# name there at all, which is why the menu was showing raw codes like
# A code missing from this file is not an error: the menu falls back to
# the bank's own name for it, so a new competition appears the day it is
# priced and can be written out here afterwards.
